source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew verse numbering align throughout Exodus 19–20.

key_decisions.decision: Retains month and this-day expression without inventing a numbered date; the absence of a numbered date is explained in a note.
Preserves conditional obedience, covenant, particular treasured possession and universal ownership together.
Keeps construct kingdom of priests without deciding priestly polity structure, and distinguishes message from instruction to Moses.
Preserves boundary, edge prohibition and explicit death sanction rather than generic danger.
Takes masculine pronoun as transgressor, retains remote killing and animal scope; final permission not harmonized away.
Makes approach-to-woman sexual idiom explicit while preserving male-directed instruction without calling women impure.
Keeps progressively loud horn, sustained speaking and answering, and qol as voice, noting thunder alternative rather than asserting content absent here.
Makes deadly force of fall explicit from boundary context, preserving divine warning against gaze.
Retains Aaron’s permission and explicit distinction from priests and people, with repeated outbreak warning.
